about_the_game:
Fire Isle is a high-energy, competitive multiplayer game where up to four players wield unique flames to battle for control of a dynamic, ever-changing map. The objective? Dominate the battlefield by collecting Wisps, ethereal flames that appear randomly across the map. Be the first to burn their tiles - or risk losing them when they move after a set number of turns. As resources grow scarce and strategies collide, only the most cunning fires will survive!

Challenge yourself to hone your skills solo or take the chaos online with up to 4 players. Box out your rivals, claim the most tiles, and collect Wisps until the strongest Fire wins! With fast-paced gameplay and ever-shifting strategies Fire Isle is a must-play for anyone who loves intense multiplayer action against their friends.

Sparks fuel your fire, but Ashes fuel your ambitions. Every fire will eventually burn out, but when they do they leave Ash behind for you to use. Spend it to unleash devastating abilities, secure powerful upgrades, or sabotage your rivals.

Always keep the Isle's terrain in mind, it's as unpredictable as your opponents! Ignite Coal Deposits, erupt Volcanoes, and even spend Ashes to burn through Snow, Sand, and Mountains, adapting your strategy as resources continue to dwindle.

These features are still being actively developed and aren't quite ready yet - however - they're going to be a huge part of Fire Isle when it releases!

WISPS

Already mentioned above, Wisps are the key to victory, and claiming them requires both speed and precision.

CLASSES & CARDS

6 RPG-style classes are inbound, each with their own unique abilities and game-shaking upgrades for players to master!

Classes:

  • Storm Caster - Rain focused build

    • This class not only survives, but thrives in the rain!

    • Able to summon rainstorms at will

  • Wisp Fiend – Wisp focused build

    • Lacking more pretentious methods, this class keeps it's eyes on the prize - Wisps

    • Able to outright purchase Wisps for the right price...

  • Trapper – Trap focused build

    • While everyone can place basic traps, this class takes it to a whole other level!

    • Able to annoy your friends to the brink of insanity with a never-ending wave of devastating traps!

  • Traveler - Travel focused build

    • This class traverses across the Isle as freely as possible!

    • Able to lob their Fire short distances to get over enemy lines & and even has a small amount of passive Fire Spread!

  • Thief – Theft focused build

    • Who needs to burn their own fires when you can just steal others?

    • Able to steal enemy fires and make them their own!

  • Warden – Terrain focused build

    • This class thrives in the harsh Sand, Stone, and Snowy terrains that other fires only touch when desperate

    • Spawns with all Terrains already unlocked!

Cards:

Players can pick 1 of 3 Cards that show up periodically between turns, allowing you to craft dynamic game-changing builds!

Most Cards are fairly basic, giving small but stackable buffs to any player who wants them. Golden Cards however are much rarer, but can grant massive upgrades for you and your chosen class!

THE ITEM BOX

Item Boxes can appear between rounds, giving players wildly chaotic advantages:

  • Spark Unlock - removes your Spark Cap for a limited time, letting you unleash your full potential.

  • Cold Front - freezes your rivals’ progress by spiking their tile costs.

  • Flame Umbrella - shields you from the brutal dowsing effects of rain.

  • #1 Extinguisher - singles out your greatest rival, stacking to cripple the leading player's Spark Gain!

  • Ash Pile - temporarily doubles the Ashes you gain when your fires burn out. Used wisely, it can set you up 

  • Trap Queen - halves the Ash Cost for placing traps, so you can place tide-turning traps to your heart's content.

  • Lightning in a Bottle - resets your Lightning Cooldown, instantly giving you a fresh new start for your fires elsewhere on the Isle.

name: Fire Isle

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 @ 3.60GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (Windows 11 works perfectly fine too, I just hate it)
  • Processor: A better one
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 40 or 50 series
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes but good
  • Additional Notes: I understand not liking DLSS or Framegen, but if you have a graphics card capable - I'd recommend using it. Still looks fine to me and I'm hitting 240+fps with it lol

short_description: Set the world ablaze in Fire Isle! Choose your fire —Happy, Sad, Angry, or Grumpy— and vs. your friends online to see who can scorch the most of a tropical paradise. Keep your flames alive as rising costs, rainstorms, and other fires try to snuff you out. Can you conquer the Isle?
